content.title: Chapter 1
content.subtitle: Energy Transitions and the Climate Crisis: An Overview
content.body: Thank you for joining us for the first chapter of the Climate Change-Energy Nexus Module. We invite you to interact with the closing scenario, and to reflect on how you can take action to move these ideas from ambitions into action.

nextBlock.title: Chapter 2: Sustainable Energy for Climate Mitigation
nextBlock.cta: This chapter highlights renewable energy’s role in climate mitigation, emphasizing its low emissions, health and economic benefits, and alignment with global goals.
